all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    playlists = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not playlists:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists)
    if len(playlists) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
